title: Every (re)arm adds another close and pong handler to the same socket and runs a full backfill, so N registrations mean N close handlers, N backfills and Node listener-leak warnings

evidence.note: each startChainAntiRugListener call adds rawWs.on(close) and runs backfillSinceLastSeen
setupHeartbeat adds another pong handler each time (and a close handler at :809-814)
and once per position plus once per chain at resume
the reconnecting guard keeps the extra close handlers from starting parallel loops
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): Listener refresh accumulates raw websocket handlers

sibling_sites_checked: All listener additions on the raw socket in the slice (detector.ts:710, :771, :809). The bot.ts close handlers stack the same way on dashboard restart (AUD-BUY-008).
severity_rationale: S3: the guard prevents parallel reconnect loops, so the effect is listener growth (Node warns past 10 listeners) and repeated full backfills on the buy path; the backfill consequences are AUD-ANTIRUG-005.
recommendation: Attach the socket handlers once per provider and refresh only the filter on registration. Phase 29 (or with the OD-11 single WebSocket owner).
